Optional WikDict dictionaries
============================

Source: WikDict by Karl Bartel, https://www.wikdict.com/
Underlying data: Wiktionary contributors, https://www.wiktionary.org/
Extraction: DBnary, https://kaiko.getalp.org/about-dbnary/
Original downloads: https://www.wikdict.com/page/download
Snapshot: SQLite export 2_2026-06

The adapted dictionary data is licensed under Creative Commons
Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0).
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
The complete legal code is included in each download pack and in
third-party/Dictionary-CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt in the extension.

On-device adaptation: normalized headwords, removed multiword entries, preferred translations
linked to English lexical entries (using reverse candidates only when none
exist), retained translations and available parts of speech, deduplicated entries,
and limited each headword to ten entries. The browser stores installed entries
in 128 shards per language.

No dictionary entries are included in an installation ZIP. Users choose which
official SQLite databases to download or import directly from download.wikdict.com.
Pinned source hashes are in dictionary-sources.json; download hashes, counts,
sizes, and official source URLs are in dictionary-catalog.js. wikdict-sqlite.js
performs the adaptation on the user's device. No project-hosted data pack is needed.

These are general dictionary translations, not context-specific definitions.
Some words and meanings are missing. Chinese entries may use simplified or
traditional characters as supplied by the source. No publisher endorses this
extension. The extension's MIT license does not relicense dictionary data.
